author: KEXP
description: Singapore's sub:shaman sound off with a bold, dark sound rife with experimentation. With touches of progressive rock and electronic, the band deliver a performance of "eat my tongue" and more Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival.
title: sub:shaman performs "eat my tongue" & more Live on KEXP

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG and AXEAN present Live on KEXP in Bali with sub:shaman performing at Puri Bhagawan. Recorded August 29, 2026.

Songs:
Maraschino Mist 00:45
cheshire cat 05:25
choke well 08:48
understanza 12:15

Live on KEXP in Bali is a partnership with AXEAN and Jimbaran Hijab. Recorded at Puri Bhagawan, in Bali, Indonesia.

Chew Wei Shan - Synth, Vocal
